integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled checker independently replays the exact rational witness and algebraic identities. Literature comparisons distinguish general multistep positivity theory from the path-specific first-post-start endpoint reduction.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the first BDF2 value after one backward-Euler startup on the uniform one-dimensional homogeneous-Dirichlet second-difference heat matrix. No claim is made for arbitrary Stieltjes matrices, nonuniform discretizations, higher dimensions, or later BDF2 steps. The source-date field uses the exact first arXiv public date of the literature anchor on positivity and monotonicity of TR-BDF2.
title: Endpoint reduction for backward-Euler-started BDF2 heat positivity
